questions.question: A woman U is the sister of V. V is W’s parent, but V’s gender is not given. Which detail is still needed to name U specifically as W’s paternal aunt or maternal aunt?

options.label: B
options.text: Whether V is W’s father or mother

options.label: C
options.text: Whether W is male or female

options.label: D
options.text: Whether U is older than W

questions.explanation: The paternal or maternal side depends on V’s role, not W’s gender or age.

questions.question: At a Patiala ceremony, a girl, Avni, introduces a man: “He is my grandmother’s son-in-law and my mother’s husband.” Which relation is explicitly established?
questions.explanation: The second statement directly identifies him as Avni’s mother’s husband.

questions.question: Code: X + Y means X is Y’s daughter; X - Y means X is Y’s father; X @ Y means X is Y’s wife. Which insertion makes A the paternal grandmother of D in A __ B - C - D?
questions.explanation: B is C’s father and C is D’s father; A must be B’s wife, so insert @.

questions.question: Jasbir’s father’s elder brother is married to Kulwant. Which Punjabi relationship correctly identifies Kulwant, a woman, for Jasbir?
questions.explanation: The uncle is older than Jasbir’s father, so his wife is the elder paternal aunt by marriage.

questions.question: Seven members A–G include two couples and three generations. A is B’s husband. Their only children are son C and daughter D. F is A’s granddaughter and C’s daughter. E is F’s mother. G is D’s son. Which two members form the second couple? Each child’s named parents are married to each other.
questions.explanation: F’s parents are C and E; under the stated married-parent rule they are the second couple.

questions.question: A woman, Devika, is married to Raman. Raman’s sister Neelam is married to Harsh. Which of these is Devika’s sister-in-law through her husband?
questions.explanation: Her husband Raman’s sister Neelam is Devika’s sister-in-law.

questions.question: X % Y means X is Y’s mother; X $ Y means X is Y’s brother; X & Y means X is Y’s daughter. In A & B % C $ D, what is the minimum number of females established?
questions.explanation: A is female as daughter and B as mother; C is male and D is unspecified.

questions.question: A couple has two sons and one daughter. Both sons have one daughter each; the daughter has two sons. All children in the younger generation are distinct. How many grandchildren does the couple have?
questions.explanation: Grandchildren are 1 + 1 + 2 = 4; the couple’s own children are not counted again.

questions.question: Read this verbal tree: Sohan (male) and Tara (female) are parents of daughters Uma and Vani. Uma’s son is Wasi; Vani’s daughter is Zara. The fathers of Wasi and Zara are not shown. What is Uma to Zara?
questions.explanation: Zara’s mother is Vani, whose sister is Uma.

questions.question: For the question “Is X Y’s uncle through Y’s father?”, examine I. X is brother of Z. II. Z is Y’s parent. Which judgement is valid?
questions.explanation: Together they make X a parent’s brother, but Z may be Y’s mother or father.

questions.question: A woman, Rachna, points to a boy: “His maternal grandmother is my mother, and his mother is not me.” Which relationship joins Rachna to the boy?
questions.explanation: The boy’s mother is another daughter of Rachna’s mother, hence Rachna’s sister.

questions.question: Use X / Y for X is Y’s father, X + Y for X is Y’s son, X * Y for X is Y’s sister. Which expression establishes A as B’s brother, even though A is not first?
questions.explanation: B * A makes B A’s sister, and A + C proves A is male; therefore A is B’s brother.

questions.question: A man, Pranav, has a daughter Ria. Pranav’s mother’s sister is Sushma; Sushma’s son is Keshav. What is Sushma to Ria’s father?
questions.explanation: Ria’s father is Pranav; Sushma is Pranav’s mother’s sister.

questions.question: Eight people form a family. P is husband of Q; R and S are their daughters. R’s husband T is father of son U. S’s husband V is father of daughter W. R and S are U’s and W’s mothers respectively. Which named man is related to U as his mother’s sister’s husband?
questions.explanation: U’s mother R has sister S; S’s husband V is U’s maternal aunt’s husband.

questions.question: X > Y means X is Y’s father; X < Y means X is Y’s daughter. In A < B > C < D, all four are distinct. Which pair must be C’s parents?
questions.explanation: B > C makes B C’s father, and C < D makes D C’s other parent.

questions.question: Ritu’s husband and Pawan’s wife are brother and sister. Pawan and Ritu are not siblings. Which description of Pawan from Ritu’s side is certain?
questions.explanation: Pawan’s wife is Ritu’s husband’s sister; Pawan is that sister’s husband.

questions.question: M is N’s father. N is O’s brother. O is P’s parent. Which pair consists of two people whose genders remain unspecified?
questions.explanation: Father fixes M as male and brother fixes N as male; neither O nor P receives a gender-specific role.

questions.question: A written tree has married couple A (male)–B (female), daughter C, son D, C’s husband E, and C–E’s sons F and G. Remove both marriage links but retain all parent–child links. Which path still connects E to A?
questions.explanation: E and C remain connected through their son F, and C is A’s daughter.

questions.question: A family contains two sisters, each with one son. The sisters’ mother is also present. Count the mother–son pairs among these five people.
questions.explanation: Each sister forms one mother–son pair with her son; the eldest woman’s children here are daughters.

questions.question: X # Y means X is Y’s father; X $ Y means X is Y’s sister; X @ Y means X is Y’s mother. In A # B __ C @ D, which symbol guarantees that A is D’s maternal grandfather?
questions.explanation: B $ C makes B and C siblings with father A; C is D’s mother.

questions.question: A woman, Simar, introduces a child: “I am the daughter of his father’s elder brother.” The child is a boy. Simar is his _____.
questions.explanation: Her father is the boy’s paternal uncle, older than the boy’s father.

questions.question: Given: A is B’s mother; B is C’s father; D is C’s sister. Conclusion I: A is D’s paternal grandmother. Conclusion II: D is A’s granddaughter through a son. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: D shares father B with C; B’s mother A is D’s paternal grandmother, so the reverse relation is granddaughter.

questions.question: X + Y means X is Y’s father, X * Y means X is Y’s wife, and X - Y means X is Y’s daughter. For P - Q * R + S, what is P’s relationship to S? Q and R are the parents of both children.
questions.explanation: P is Q’s daughter and S is R’s child; the shared-parent condition makes P S’s sister.

questions.question: Jaya and Kiran are sisters. Jaya is married to Om and Kiran to Rakesh. Om’s sister is Lata. Which woman is Rakesh’s wife’s sister?
questions.explanation: Rakesh’s wife is Kiran; her sister is Jaya, while Lata belongs to Om’s sibling branch.

questions.question: A man, Param, is brother of Nisha’s mother. Nisha’s daughter Ovi has a brother, Punit. What is Nisha’s relationship to Param?
questions.explanation: Param’s sister is Nisha’s mother, so Nisha is Param’s niece through his sister; her children do not change that.
